'''Krade''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] member of the [[Imperial Guard]] who served the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] with the rank of [[Commander/Legends|commander]] during the [[Galactic War]].

==Biography==
In [[3640 BBY]], [[Commander/Legends|Commander]] Krade served alongside [[Darth Charnus]] and [[Darth Decimus]] during the [[Battle of Corellia]]. When the [[Czerka Arms/Legends|Czerka Corporation]] created a massive army of security [[Droid/Legends|droids]] to fight against the Empire, Krade and Charnus were able to send an Imperial hero to take the [[Hull-cracker|Hull Cracker]] and use the weapon to disable two of [[Corellian Engineering Corporation/Legends|Corellian Engineering Corporation's]] signal towers. Krade and Charnus' forces defended Imperial explosives experts while they planted charges, and the Sith Lord's operatives stormed the company board room itself.
